title.zh: 英国承诺投入1亿英镑，与OpenAI和Anthropic合作建设生物安全实验室
title.en: 英国承诺投入1亿英镑，与OpenAI和Anthropic合作建设生物安全实验室

current_state.zh: The UK government committed £100 million to an AI biosecurity laboratory supported by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind, alongside additional funding for AI safety and economic research institutes and up to £200 million in donated model access.
